rationale: The discussion satisfies the recorded design task within its authority bounds. Contribution: it identifies the smallest useful extension - one optional, versioned intake/context attachment to the existing shared discussion route, reusing the checked-read, receipt and evidence-loader discipline - rather than a graph service, new charter, scoring change, replacement lifecycle or platform. Validity: the implementation inventory matches the supplied source (charter-filtered evidence_context with deliberate blinding and pending-rows-carry-dependencies-not-conclusions; proposal_context restricted to reviewed, hash-bound, unadopted charter previews; the two-round discuss stage with opposing-family, exit and runner-provenance checks; human_controls request/export bounds and the literal 'isles24-prediction' selection correctly read as existing behavior, not adoption), and it is honest that the librarian, human-controls configuration, legacy scout/rubric originals and campaign_lifecycle internals are not supplied, refusing to invent their behavior or a 'feasibility' mode the code does not define. Pin fidelity: every transcribed identity matches the supplied records exactly (campaign 7350da8a, spec d76cf92b, code d54e3ea5, decision 78da702d, historical review 18f6ace7, reviewed commit 469d29df, cohort aba52512, manifest blob edb9a8c2, snapshot 0770c7dc, scientific source d6a1184b, notebook 1a81c037, 047b candidate 940293b6 and contract dc586665), labeled as transcription rather than fresh verification, with P001's external-seed origin, Codex/GPT-6 Astra investigator and Claude historical opposing review preserved unrewritten. Required distinctions are drawn and actually used: descriptive context versus chosen charter (human-authored isles24 versus unadopted isles24-prediction/proposed-v1), and scientific blocker (source, last-checked date, observable progress criterion) versus operational dependency - the held ambiguous dispatch, changed-dependency review and 047b custody items are correctly classed as operational/evidential, not scientific demerit, and neither blocks P001 desk work. The worked example does what was asked: P001 plus the operator's actual 'predict overall patient outcome' suggestion carried with attribution, explicitly outside the present experimental envelope, its endpoint clarification marked agent-authored, and framed as a successor question rather than a selected experiment. Information gain and uncertainty are handled qualitatively and honestly: the ledger names sources, gives 2026-09-06 supplied-text check dates with primary verification marked unavailable (and the spec's 2026-09-05 hosting check attributed correctly), states what evidence would move each question, and distinguishes gap identification from resolution; no literature search, measurement, performance number or heterogeneity finding is invented. Assumption-challenging and unlinked ideas remain discussable without linkage-, keyword- or blocker-proximity-derived credit anywhere, satisfying the no-automatic-score constraint; context stays non-prescriptive. Resources are proportionate: metadata/document-only, existing subscriptions, finite documented attachment limits within existing request/publication ceilings, no new service, provisioning, credentials or spending. Human usability is addressed with a readable intake preview, status-queries-leave-work-running and task/revision-bound steering semantics, while phone/hosted/recovery behavior is correctly reported as unexercised rather than claimed. Boundaries hold throughout: no scoring, ratification, artifact edits, philosophy attributions, self-generated review or receipts; P001's frozen contract (finite Tmax>6.0, predict-before-label, 99/49 cohort discipline, mean patient Dice, seed 20260905 with 2000 resamples, 60-minute CPU cap, five-file manifest) and the baseline-plus-two envelope are restated unchanged; roadmap status and the superseded no-server preference are treated as historical assertions; migration is a described handoff keeping the three immutable server task bindings untouched pending the explicit task-amendment route; and the architecture is repeatedly and explicitly not a prerequisite for P001. The minimal implementation and verification section proposes a bounded adapter with concrete synthetic acceptance cases (provenance preservation, hash/symlink/cycle/staleness rejection, blinding and charter-eligibility non-bypass, conflict preservation, no duplicate execution, no new P001 prerequisite) instead of building anything now. Minor residual points - illustrative context labels, untested verification prose, and the reliance on the request's own wording for the operator suggestion - are already disclosed within the document and do not warrant revision.
